description: T8 page composition — the two Mahout UI pages (Pipelines, Pipeline) composed from the platform Prism axiom components (pipelines-gallery, pipeline-fluxboard, pipeline-detail-window), the Prism composition definition (PrismCompositionModel documents), and the runnable composed-app harness. Interim composition artifact: the platform's Workshop composition (PrismCompositionService authoring + OS runtime) is not yet available for the Mahout application; this repository carries the exact composition documents plus the binding runtime that executes them, and records the missing platform capabilities. Released through jumbo to the JumboIndex only; never published to a public registry.
name: @juntai/mahout-pages-app
